name: Marmite
description: Concentrated brewer's yeast, salty and bitter — a scrape is a serving.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; a concentrated yeast product.

histamine.note: Yeast extract is one of the highest-histamine foods by weight, though the serving is tiny.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
